meta.grade_key: Grade = our estimated hit probability after blending with DK's price. Edge is shown separately. A+>=85 A>=80 A->=75 B 68-74 C 60-67 D<60 F=hard hold; modifiers for form, price, matchup, target competition.

no shared legs across tickets (A+ may anchor two)
floor rung is the floor rung
never a leg we know is overpriced
no attempt props when favored by 7+
